name: Giana's Return
author: Rodolphe Boixel (Thor)
description_short: Free unofficial sequel to The Great Giana Sisters, where Giana rescues her sister Maria.
description_long: Evil Swampy has stolen the magic ruby and kidnapped Giana's sister Maria. Play as Giana in this free, unofficial sequel to The Great Giana Sisters: recover the ruby, save Maria, and find your way home across seven worlds of platforming action.

license.notes: The official release is freeware but does not declare an SPDX-compatible license. The included README requires written permission for redistribution.
